description: A use site whose literal attributes provably break the declaration's invariant (min 60 > max 10): E-WRITE-INVARIANT.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rule 9: a use site whose attribute values are literals (`<slider min=60 max=10/>`) is a provable case of E-WRITE-INVARIANT.
